      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/base.cpp, and related headers to support pruned operation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex to run concurrently with block pruning on databases without legacy offset entries, solving a long-standing storage pain point. PR description notes that previously '-txindex and -prune have historically been mutually exclusive because txindex entries referenced absolute block file offsets', allowing storage-constrained nodes to index transactions without hundreds of gigabytes of raw block files."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extends JSONRPCError with structured error data in src/rpc/util.cpp and alters return/error behavior across rawtransaction, rest, and node RPCs.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends JSON-RPC error handling to surface missing block hashes so callers can retrieve pruned blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer. Reviewers also raised potential compatibility concerns regarding 'synced: true' semantics in getindexinfo for clients not checking first_block_height."
    },
